title: Helper and Comforter
definition: Helper and Comforter are descriptions of the Holy Spirit's ministry of strengthening, teaching, guiding, reminding, and sustaining believers.
summary: The Holy Spirit is the Helper promised by Jesus to be with His people.
christFocus: Jesus sends another Helper so His disciples are not left alone.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus promised another Helper, the Holy Spirit. The Spirit comes alongside God's people to teach, remind, guide, convict, strengthen, and sustain.

The Spirit's help does not replace Christ's presence; it mediates Christ's presence to His people. Through the Spirit, believers are not left as orphans.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers often feel alone in weakness, confusion, or suffering. This doctrine matters because Jesus has not abandoned His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Call on the Lord for the Spirit's help. Receive His comfort through Scripture, prayer, and the body of Christ, and comfort others with the comfort you receive.
